care_years_1_3: Water your young tree through the warm months while it settles in.
Plant it in a sunny spot with soil that drains well.
Protect young plants from frost; older trees cope with light frost.
Keep a weed-free circle with mulch around the trunk, not touching it.
golden-wattle.wildlife: Golden wattle attracts insects and birds; small honey-eating birds visit for nectar.

schima.size_basis: Height: CUHK Shiu-Ying Hu Herbarium 5-20 m; HK Greening Office up to 20 m. Spread: NC State 10-30 ft (converted from feet at 0.3048 m per foot), from trees grown in North Carolina.
schima.small_note: Schima grows into a tall evergreen tree, so it suits parks, hillsides and big gardens.
care_years_1_3: Water your young tree through the warm months while it settles in.
Keep a weed-free circle about 1 m wide, with a mulch about 10 cm deep.
Fit a guard round the trunk if rabbits or other animals nibble bark.
If you used a stake, take it away after two to three years.
schima.wildlife: Schima's white summer flowers attract bees and scarab beetles.
